notes: 19 key claims, 22 repo quotes and 10 external/timeline items checked. Repo claims were re-read at 257856e and worked numbers recomputed independently in Node. Operation counts were matched to the values the repo's tests pin; bun test was refused by the sandbox, so they are asserted-by-test, not observed passing. Key claims 1-3 and 5-19 are confirmed. Claim 4 is confirmed, but its wording 'only in a lab example' is refined (correction 3).

corrections.original: Brent & Kung's own paper gives the same figures: about 2 log2 n - 2 delay levels and 2n - log2 n - 2 cells; Brent & Kung accepted 2 log2 n - 2 levels and got about 2n cells (sections 4, 5.4, S19)
corrections.fix: The 1982 paper states time proportional to log n. Theorem 3 gives carries in O(log n) time and O(n log n) area, and the abstract and section 6 give O(n) area with pipelining. Its n = 16 network (Fig. 5) finishes at T = 7. The exact counts 2k-2-log2 k and 2 log2 k - 2 come from the repo (prefix-networks.ts#L28-L29) and later literature, not from the paper.

corrections.original: HandwiredOS's Monitor list shows 'Only 64 rows are drawn at a time.' (cited to value-list.ts#L434-L435 and #L753)
corrections.fix: The string is built at value-list.ts#L664 as `Only ${slotCount} rows are drawn at a time.`, with slotCount = 64 at L63. L434-L435 compute slotOverflow, and L753 shows the message when slotOverflow is 1. The quote itself is verbatim in behavior-choices.md#L87.

corrections.original: Kogge-Stone appears only in a lab example (key claim 4; misconception 1)
corrections.fix: Kogge-Stone is absent from src/, but in lab/ it appears in more than one example. Lab code builds it (prefix-sums.ts#L78, plus executor.test.ts and report.ts; 9,217 ops in 10 layers at 1,024 rows). Lab docs discuss it: chains.md#L103, executor.md#L440/L485/L489 and loops.md#L32. The old index-read prototype and an earlier lists phase used it (lists/README.md#L219). Ladner-Fischer never appears; 'Ladner 1975' appears once, for the circuit value problem (chains.md#L174).

corrections.original: Sklansky quote: 'the maximum fanout is an increasing function of the summand length'
corrections.fix: No primary text was reachable (the Berkeley copy returned 404). Keep it labelled UNVERIFIED — do not use as a quote.
